about: Parameters for SnakeList's procedural 3D snake models (species/3d/viewer.js). Lengths are metres; body.ld is length / mid-body diameter; head.len is head length / total length; head.w is head width / body width; pattern positions use t (0 = snout, 1 = tail tip) along the body and a around it (0 = middle of the back, 0.5 = flank, 1 = belly midline); head markings use xn (0 = snout tip, 1 = back of the head). Every profile cites the references its shape, colours and scenery were taken from. The build copies this file to species/3d/models.json.
